steps.en: Officer opens a page to configure the court-stage ATOMS amount
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman untuk mengatur nominal ATOMS di court stage
steps.why_en: Only a menu name exists; no ATOMS configuration screen is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama menu yang ada; layar konfigurasi ATOMS tidak dibuat.

steps.en: Officer sets the extra amount added at the court stage
steps.id: Officer mengatur nominal tambahan yang ditambahkan di court stage
steps.why_en: It is set through the general parameter list, not a court or ATOMS-specific setting.
steps.why_id: Diatur lewat daftar parameter umum, bukan pengaturan khusus court atau ATOMS.

steps.en: At the court stage the amount payable is the extra amount plus composition amount
steps.id: Di court stage amount payable adalah nominal tambahan ditambah composition amount

steps.en: The court amount applies automatically after the summons payment due date passes
steps.id: Nominal court berlaku otomatis setelah payment due date summons lewat
steps.why_en: After the due date only payment is closed, and that job is not scheduled; the amount does not change by itself.
steps.why_id: Setelah due date hanya pembayaran ditutup, dan job itu tidak terjadwal; nominal tidak berubah sendiri.

steps.en: The amount set by the State Courts is accepted as the amount payable
steps.id: Nominal yang ditetapkan State Courts diterima sebagai amount payable
steps.why_en: It arrives as data from another system, not as an officer setting, and is not checked against the fine.
steps.why_id: Datang sebagai data dari sistem lain, bukan pengaturan officer, dan tidak dicek terhadap denda.
